ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The purple drawer holds the Canada file. ... The yellow drawer holds the Thailand file. ... The blue drawer holds the Italy file. ... Which colour is the drawer that holds the file on the country whose capital is Bangkok?" -> answer org yellow; the alt prompt asks about the Italy (bridge alt), its 2nd statement. Possible answers after the patch: blue (answer of bridge alt's statement), purple (answer at the same statement slot), pink (the alt prompt's own answer), yellow (answer org kept).

example_lines.e8-digit: org prompt "... The skull chart is in folder 2. ... The ear chart is in folder 0. ... The wrist chart is in folder 4. ... Which folder holds the chart on the body part that protects the brain?" -> answer org 2; the alt prompt asks about the wrist (bridge alt), its 4th statement. Possible answers after the patch: 4 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 0 (answer at the same statement slot), 7 (the alt prompt's own answer), 2 (answer org kept).
